Are you passionate about Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions? Do you have excellent skills in Dutch and English? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!

Identity-Team B.V., a leading consulting firm specializing in IAM solutions, is seeking a highly skilled Identity Consultant to join our dynamic team. As an Identity Consultant, you will play a crucial role in delivering top-notch IAM services to our clients.

Tasks

- Collaborate with clients to understand their IAM requirements and develop tailored solutions using ForgeRock.

- Implement and configure IAM solutions based on industry best practices.

- Provide expertise and guidance throughout the entire project lifecycle.

- Conduct workshops and training sessions to educate clients on IAM principles and best practices.

- Occasionally travel to client sites to provide on-site support and consulting services.

Requirements

- Fluency in Dutch and English, both spoken and written.

- Strong knowledge and experience with ForgeRock/Ping Identity IAM solutions.

- Proven track record in delivering successful IAM projects.

- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong client-facing and interpersonal skills.

- Willingness to travel occasionally.

If you are a self-motivated professional seeking a challenging role in the dynamic field of IAM consulting, we would love to hear from you. Join our team at Identity-Team and take your career to new heights!

We are proud of our diverse and dedicated team of staff, volunteers and interns, who represent different backgrounds, nationalities, and ages. Discover below our volunteer and internship opportunities in The Hague. 
 Volunteering 
Volunteers are integral to our mission, contributing to various projects that align with their skills and interests. While we welcome individuals from all professional and academic backgrounds, experience in archival studies, library sciences, marketing, or social media is particularly valued. We provide role-specific training to ensure every volunteer is well-prepared. 
We look for enthusiastic, curious, and computer-literate individuals interested in social history. Volunteering takes place at our office in The Hague on an agreed day of the week. We ask for a commitment of at least 6 hours per week for a minimum of 6 months. Our opening hours are from 10:00 to 16:00, Monday through Thursday. English is the working language. All applicants must hold a valid EU work permit. 
There are two main groups of volunteers: archival and content creator. Occasionally, we offer project-specific volunteering opportunities that may require particular skills. All available volunteer openings are listed on this page. We also accept open applications for archival and content creator volunteers year-round. 
Are you looking for a volunteer opportunity? Submit your volunteer application .

As a Field Service Panel Builder Technician, you will work on a variety of electrical installations at customer sites throughout the Netherlands. Your responsibilities include assembling, installing, connecting, commissioning and maintaining electrical distribution systems and control panels. You will work both on-site with customers and in the workshop. At customer locations, you ensure that electrical installations are installed safely, correctly and according to specifications. You will also troubleshoot electrical faults, identify the root cause of problems and provide effective solutions to get the customer's installation back up and running as quickly as possible. Your work is both electrical and mechanical, making this a varied and hands-on position. You will build cabinets based on electrical schematics, connect electrical installations and, when required, interconnect panels on-site when they cannot be transported as a single unit. You will also have direct contact with customers and coordinate your activities with them to ensure that installation and service work causes as little disruption to their operations as possible. During periods with less field service work, you will support the workshop team by building electrical panels based on technical drawings and schematics. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A varied technical position combining field service, panel building and electrical installation. Work at different customer locations throughout the Netherlands. A high level of independence and responsibility in your daily work. Opportunities to develop your technical skills through relevant training and education. The opportunity to obtain additional certifications such as VCA and NEN 3140. A combination of workshop-based and customer-facing work. Participation in on-call and breakdown services. 25 vacation days and 13 ADV days Wat levert deze baan jou op? A lot of variety. You will not be doing the same thing every day. and deal with different electrical installations and technical challenges. Hands-on technical work. You will work directly with electrical distribution systems, control panels and electrical installations, allowing you to put your practical skills to use every day. Independence and responsibility. You will have the freedom to investigate technical problems, determine the best solution and carry out your work independently. Technical challenge. The combination of electrical and mechanical work makes this a broad and challenging position where you will continuously encounter different technical situations. Room to develop. You will have the opportunity to follow relevant courses and training and further develop your career within electrical engineering, panel building and service. Strong practical and technical skills. Able to analyse technical problems and troubleshoot faults independently. Accurate, safety-conscious and responsible in your work.
